Bu oyun benim hayatımı değiştiren ve impact eden oyunlardan birtanesi çok iyi arkadaşım betonrausch ile havuz bile yaptık. Yaptığımız plank hilesinin haddi hesabı olmasada oyundaki en güzel rafta biz sahibiz bu oyuna verdiğim zaman ve para %1000000 değmiştir herkese önerilir yanlız köpekbalığı heran elinizi ayağınızı sikip anlık kalp krizlerine yol açabilir. Onun dışında mama bear ile teke tek açılmayın (önerilmez). Oynayabilceğiniz en iyi survival oyunlardan birtanesi. Burak piçiyle oynamayın önerilmez ve afk kalmayın 1 saat afk kaldık köpekbalığı geminin anasını sikmiş bütün gemiyi yemiş aç orospu çocuğu. Neyse alıcaksanız alın baya kaliteli.
Fun little hard to get going but once you do its cool to see what you can do.

Got this game a while ago when it first dropped but at the time i only ended up spending an hour or so in there, came back to it this week and i've been really enjoying it so far. Nice visuals, nice music and it feels like a very chilled out gaming experience. Also i was pleased to see there was a 'motion sickness' option which was great for me or anyone who has issues with that. Nice little addition i thought. 10/10 for me thus far. Would recommend :)

Where to start? I have been loving this game. ♡
At my first try, I stopped playing after a while, since I didn't understand the goal. ( •̯́ ^ •̯̀)
Later on I played with friends and luckily they did understand. And it has been a blast!~
We made a cool raft, had most of the upgrades and finished the story.
It was really fun from start to finish ^^
Now we will play again, and I am still having a lot of fun!
The story is great, the building aspect is really fun and the combat is a little challenge at times.
It's more about figuring out what to do, then hitting hard.
Raft feels like a survival, puzzle game. But touches a lot, gaming wise. *.✩ ⭒
I kept wondering what the story will bring and with every island we discovered, it delivered.
The adventure pulled me in, the puzzles kept me going. The story tied it together nicely.
All in all, if you like adventure, puzzle, stories, progressing, easy-going cosy games, then this is a game for you. ◝(ᵔᵕᵔ)◜

The game is quite fun at the start. The further you progress, it feels as if it gets grindier in some ways, and less in others. The shark also makes it much too difficult to go deep underwater early-game without taking damage. It's possible to kill the shark, but you only have about three minutes before it respawns.

I do really enjoy the speed of updates and the activity of the developers with the community. I think Raft will be quite a fun game when it releases, as long as there's a way to make the shark stop being so annoying!

It deserves its award for being best with friends, the story is fun and puzzles aren't too bad up until the end. It takes patience, it's survival, but it's colorful, fun, and pretty re-playable. The last area(s) get a bit finicky, but the game is worth finishing.
Excellent game, it can be as chill or challenging as you'd like. Build a raft, float around the ocean, explore new islands.

This game is amazingly fun, basic and great with some friends! This game i very good for beta, it can be improved massively and hopefully will be!

boat in ocean, find food, clean water, and don't get eaten, and a surprising amount of lore, stab shark to death, shark is reincarnated 5 minutes later. 10/10

10/10

i ended up starving myself and swimming into the ocean with a shark head, i died in the next 5 seconds as 3 sharks came on me. I didn't know I died until I felt a burning sensation, I then realized I was in hell.
One of my friends is scared of the ocean and stays on the boat while we force the other to fish and it's slowly driving them insane. Great game, 10/10 recommend.

Love the game at least for my taste, but easy to reach to the point where it become very repetitive after a while and. Islands look very similar like just 5 kinds of them in total. But it's still in early access, so I hope it's coming for more and be more adventurous like missions or some sort. I hope there are more items to craft, more islands to explore: literally able to explore ON the island; not just set foot and grab things and back to the raft. More threats, not just sharks, but like kraken or sth. Just expecting more, I stopped playing, because it becomes repetitive and nothing to do anymore, still recommend try it out though.
Its very fun to play with friends around 3-4 people also be aware of the sharks when you fall into the water
Its fun to play with friends, but I don`t see it as a really good story telling game, and it gets boring floating on water after a while

Amazing game, solid all the way through. Crafting menu is intuitive and easy to use, character controls well, story is well put together and keeps you going where you need to without ever forcing your hand. I've played the crap out of this game, one of my all time favorite Steam games for sure.

At $20 I do not recomend this game the content alone is maybe .... maybe worth $15 if that. Beat the game very easy not really much to do tbh very boring with little content dissapointed could become much better. will update.

Thirst and hunger simulation. Comfy sea adventure. Game about saving the environment and yet have you spent tons of resources just to make a simple bowl and throw it away after a single use. Realistic/10
it is very fun and you can play with friends. The entire game is an adventure and there's new things to discover every corner you take. If you're bored and need something new, definitely recommend!
good sandbox survival game and i dont know its just fun after you get good

Quite the fun game with a challenge. Plus its got a sprinkle of fear to those of you who are afraid of sharks. Well rounded building mechanics and not too demanding when it come to computer specs, you gotta love the combo and top it off with multiplayer and you have a game that you can challenge yourself to survive in this watery world.

great simple little game. just needs missions and quests and it be much better.
still worth the relaxing gametime.

Ive been playing this game for a while now, and I can truthfuly say its one of my favorites. Its not amazing for its depth, for something like that you can go to one of the many other similar styles of games. Its amazing for its atmosphere. Me and my girlfriend sit down for about an hour and play Raft Coop together before we get to bed.

The music is great, the graphics perfect, and the mechanics simple and easy to understand, even for a total beginner to the genre. If youre looking for a complex survival crafting game where youll never run out of things to see and do, Raft isnt for you. But if youre looking for a nice relaxing game to play with a partner or friends, this one might just hit the spot.

I can't... Stop... Playing. I absolutely adore every element of this game. There's room for creativity, so much customisation, and single-player madness while leaving room for story and progression. I've played with other people online, which was so much fun, and I consider the raft my partner and my's first home, because we spent hours and hours building it together and laughing on mic about the game, where things should go. Okay granted, it's early access, so I finished the game ages ago. At this point, I'm just making my raft the baddest thing on the seas, and building this ridiculous stronghold of items and resources. I could not recommend more.

A fun game to play with friends, a good game overall with a few bugs (none gamebreaking).Also, It needs some optimization for multiplayer. Now i'm waiting for the devs to release new content, hopefully it's good 7/10.

Raft is one of the best experiences I've had gaming with friends in years. Between the fun gameplay loop, base building while having to maintain ship duties and even the combat and story the fun does not stop. The story is a great ride with some twist you don't see coming and actually pushes you to keep going even during downtime. Voice acting is done well and its nice to see the cast of characters all have their outfits to mix and match.

Overall I would recommend this game every time if you and someone you know are trying to sit back and relax over a voice call. The developers cooked and hope their success in the future.

For the first time opening the game and playing it with friends there have been a few bugs, the game is getting more exciting and challenging but the longer you play the more frequent the bugs are. One of the most serious bugs where I often find is that it is difficult to join a friend's host, I've been looking for a way to overcome it but all the suggestions on the internet don't help. In the end, only luck could get me to play on a friend's host.

Extremely fun game with an actually pretty good survival gameplay loop considering most survival aspects aren't just essentialy thrown away after you get higher in the tech tree like most do.
The combat feels extremely rewarding when you actually understand it especially with dealing with Bruce and the other looming threats.
This wasn’t for me as a solo experience but I had a blast once I got someone to play it with. We completed the story but never finished building the raft of our dreams. The possibilities are endless!

Good Game great start but After few hrs after achieving the mission & build a big raft

keep it up
good survival. the game is not stressful, has nice graphics and history. not a bad multiplayer, it's more interesting in co-op. definitely justifies its cost

Fun, unique take on the survival genre. A bit challenging at the beginning but quite chill and relaxing one you get set up properly. Simple but well designed building system. Easy recommendation for anyone that likes the genre, I waited too long to finally give it a shot!
very fun game! if your depth perception is not great this game may be a little funky lol, that makes it a little better tho! silly silly game and even more fun with friends!!

Me and my brother played this game together and it only took us a total of 21 hours to beat it on normal mode. The game seems to have a lot of potential and fun progression. The problem is that most of the progression in the game is either not worth your time or not necessary. There isn't a reason to farm an immense amount of resources especially if you're trying to complete the story. the amount of food and water you have to drink is more tedious than anything. there were multiple craft-able items that we just didn't bother using like almost any item involving titanium because by the time you get titanium, the game is almost finished. The game isn't terrible don't get me wrong. But I don't think i see a lot of replay-ability unless its with a full group of friends where there's more people to upkeep certain areas around the raft. i've seen a few people on hear with hundreds of hours on the game and if you like the game that much good for you. i just don't see why you'd play the game THAT much. I'm recommending the game though just because i think its a game that can be worth the time to play with a friend or two for the one time. and since the game isn't crazy expensive i don't think you'll see yourself saying you wasted your money.

If u have a "friend" that could play this game with u, BUY IT!
Raft, is an experience, an experience not all will understand, not all will have the patience, the time, and the money to purchase such an exquisite game, but nonethless it is an amazing game.

Raft is a fine although somewhat short game, the amount of content is limited and the story isn't too long, but is a nice experience as the world is actually somewhat crafted instead of procedurally generated.

Very good when alone with tons of content and lore and even better with friends. Great preformence and expansive story up to 30 hours, 10/10.

Hello everyone!

This is one of the most chill and new player friendly survival games on the market. It's also very bright and does not give you an injection of anxiety. Progression and learning curve are perfectly set, you feel like you are learning with each hour played. The end game, when the game launched, was lacking a lot, and you would feel kind of sad for not having more of it. However, to my surprise, they are still adding content, and its more and more fun. It might seen overpriced, but I'm telling you, you will squeeze 100s of hours from this one, especially with friends!

This is one of the best coop-games I ever played, honestly. Everything fits very well into the atmosphere of the game while playing. May it be the music or simply the decorations. It is like every little aspect of the game tells you "You are alone". Well, ignoring your coop-partner of course.
The one thing I can think of thats not that good is only the developers publishing only huge updates with a lot of time in between them. I wish they would add more and more smaller things with shorter intervalls between updates. But all in all, for me, this game was really really worth the money.

The game turned out to be very interesting and exciting. Raft survival, great simulator. By entering this game, you can relax and enjoy the excellent gameplay and have fun. Unfortunately for one, it is not very interesting there, but with friends, the game rises to another level. \ (★ ω ★) /

If you enjoy building games where you can make whatever comes to mind with limits such as rafts building blocks, I'm sure you will 100% love the game! Not only is it story-mode survival but it allows you to continue playing and exploring once story-mode is finished. Achievements in the game make you want to continue exploring and creating past whats simply "necessary".

Raft is one from many other survival games that uses oceanic setting. And It really feels fresh, but only for a couple of hours. Then you start noticing how the devs poorly managed this unique concept.
The game suffers badly from the lack of the content, so the developers decided to build several obstacles to hide it and make the game longer.
For instance, your character is always hungry and thirsty, so you have to carry a lot of food because the food doesn't recover much energy.
The next thing is your inventory. You don't have much space, and the size of a stuck is limited to 20 pieces of something. This is too small number. You can easily fill up your inventory just by simply running around your raft for 5 mins and collecting the garbage gathered by the nests.
And one more annoying thing is story islands, having huge size and being 90% empty is such a disappointment for this game, You have to prepare a lot of food beforehand to board them.

I think this game deserves the neutral recommendation.
I hope other developers will learn from these mistakes and make a better game in this setting.

This Is A Very Good game and i would like to address the beauty in the water and the art in each and every object there is in the game. I would recommend it but it does need a few bug fixes in the working!

This game is amazing! The graphics are really good, and so is the story! I would HIGHLY recommend this to people who like survival games and story games. It is a mix of Minecraft, Bonelab, Boneworks, and Gmod!

I bought and playthrough this game alone back when the first version launched, and after the final chapter update, I completed it two more times with friends. In total, I've finished three full playthroughs, which says a lot about how fun and replayable the game is. It does a great job blending survival, exploration, and puzzle-solving, and each main story chapter features thoughtfully designed levels that impressed me more than once. The co-op experience is especially enjoyable and makes the game even more entertaining.

My only real complaint is that some of the achievements are ridiculously designed. The game simply isn't big enough to earn them naturally, so you're forced to grind if you want 100% completion. For example, even after three complete playthroughs, I was still nowhere close to the achievement for killing a certain type of enemy and had to resort to save scumming to finish it. The buried treasure achievement was even worse. It took three playthroughs plus nearly a month of intensive digging before I finally collected them all. That's just absurd.

早在第一版就入手，更新最终章后又和朋友通关两次。总共完整的通关了三个周目，可见这个游戏的可玩性和乐趣还是非常高的。将生存冒险和解密有机的结合到了一起，主线每个章节的副本设计都还蛮用心的，玩的时候不止一次被惊艳到。并且多人游玩更欢乐。美中不足是有些成就的条件设置非常不合理，因为游戏的体量并不足以正常达成这些成就，那想拿就必须硬刷，比如说杀特定怪物的成就我三周目完成都差很多，只能用SL大法去杀，还有挖掘收集宝物的成就，三周目外加将近一个月的高强度挖才挖全。就离谱。

Raft is a survival game that has found a way to make everything annoying. when your character is hungry/thirsty, an extremely annoying sound effect will start to play on loop, and reduce your movement speed. In this game where the world is covered in water, the devs heavily discourage you from touching it whatsoever by having a shark attack you. To make this worse, one of the most important structures in the early game is locked behind the shark, with each method to get rid of it being only short term and expensive. If you are looking for a coop survival game, i would instead recomend grounded or wait for subnautica 2

tldr.text: Very Positive (94%): players praise the co-op and the story.
Bugs and crashes are the top complaint, though fewer recent reviews raise them.

details.text: Recent reviews are a little less positive, yet bug complaints have eased to 5% of recent reviews, down from 10% overall.
Players in their first hours are much less positive than veterans, who sit at 97%.
